'''''Tyranny Reborn''''' was a [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]] directed by [[Ch'been]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Tyranny Reborn'' was an early rumored title for [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'' Episode II]].
